channel.discord.desc: Send messages through a Discord channel webhook
channel.discord.field.url.desc: Channel webhook address; its token stays in the request only
channel.discord.field.username.desc: Display name overriding the webhook name; omitted when it renders empty
channel.discord.field.avatarUrl.desc: Avatar address overriding the webhook avatar; checked as an http/https URL when non-empty
channel.discord.error.invalid_url: {{.URL}} is not a valid webhook address
channel.discord.error.empty_content: title and body are both empty
channel.discord.error.invalid_avatar_url: {{.URL}} is not a valid avatar address
channel.discord.warn.truncated: message content was cut at the {{.Limit}} UTF-16 code unit limit
